earnings.title: November 4, 2026
highlights: Third quarter net sales of $7.9 billion, an increase of 10.4%
Third quarter net income of $318 million, a decrease of 1.2%
Nine months net sales of $22.9 billion, an increase of 10.9%
Nine months net income of $696 million, a decrease of 28.8%
Third quarter 2026 net sales increased 10.4% to $7.9 billion, compared to $7.1 billion in the third quarter 2025, with Organic Sales¹ increasing 10.5%.

quotes.text: Medline delivered another strong quarter, with double-digit net sales growth, reflecting continued momentum across our business.
quotes.by: Jim Boyle, chief executive officer of Medline

outlook: Raising full year 2026 Organic Sales 2 guidance to 10.0% to 10.5% from 9.0% to 10.0% and reaffirming Adjusted EBITDA 2 guidance of $3.3 billion to $3.4 billion

The Company is raising its full year 2026 outlook for Organic Sales 2 growth to 10.0% to 10.5%, compared to its previous outlook of 9.0% to 10.0%, and reaffirming its Adjusted EBITDA 2 outlook of $3.3 billion to $3.4 billion.
Consistent with prior guidance, the Adjusted EBITDA outlook does not reflect IEEPA tariff refunds, including the $324 million of net tariff benefit through the first nine months of 2026.
Guidance for full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA excludes $324 million of net tariff refunds through the first nine months of 2026.
